title: abryanthemum edule
intro: Abryanthemum edule, commonly known as the edible chrysanthemum, is a type of flowering plant native to the mountainous regions of East Asia. The edible chrysanthemum is valued for its health benefits, which include its ability to lower cholesterol levels, reduce blood pressure, and improve liver function. The plant's therapeutic actions include its anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antiviral properties, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including flavonoids, saponins, and polysaccharides. These bioactive compounds have been shown to exhibit immunomodulatory and hepatoprotective effects, making the edible chrysanthemum a potentially valuable natural remedy for various health conditions.
